name: familiar
description: A pixel-art companion above the prompt that reacts to your session, levels up, and can be redrawn by hand

quips.title: Quips
quips.description: Let it react to finished turns with a short line from Haiku (uses a few tokens)

quipMinutes.title: Minutes between quips
quipMinutes.description: At most one quip in this many minutes

size.title: Sprite size
size.description: full draws each pixel as a square, exactly as the editor shows it. compact draws it at half size with half-block characters, which show thin gaps in terminals with line or letter spacing above 1.
